startup_actions: stop legacy and prior v3 service processes
apply idempotent SQL migrations and resilience indexes
start five current production components through monitored service wrappers
require HTTP readiness from all five health endpoints
open web service only after functional readiness
invariants: unknown RFID is not counted as a reel unless later confirmed by valid Warehouse/1C evidence
Warehouse Tag is optional; Ids and SeriesNumber are mandatory identity values
Warehouse resolution priority is TAG then IDS then unique SERIES
ambiguous SeriesNumber never auto-links
persisted WarehouseId wins over a closer unlinked event
WAREHOUSE_ONLY rows are rechecked for late physical RFID for 168 hours
physical RFID with RfidReadCount>0 may be promoted from UNKNOWN_RFID by Warehouse evidence
RFID checkpoint advances atomically with event/session state
pending local spool records are not deleted before delivery
RFID readiness includes semantic business-flow health, not only process/TCP health
confirmed silent RFID failure remains red across restarts until a new fresh RFID read is persisted
delayed stale RFID backlog cannot clear a confirmed live-reader fault
RFID main loop and durable SQL delivery thread are independently watchdog-protected
RTSP reconnect activity is distinguished from a capture thread blocked inside OpenCV/FFmpeg
RusGuard failed iterations do not refresh its progress watchdog
aggregator failed iterations do not refresh its progress watchdog
post-COMMIT telemetry failure cannot roll back aggregator in-memory business state
RusGuard cursor advances across unrelated source rows using a bounded source high-watermark snapshot
startup success requires all five /health/ready endpoints to report ready
existing Zabbix/Sentry architecture uses health ports 18101-18105 and must not be silently replaced
production config_v3.cmd is local-only and must never be committed
